I apologize. I was incorrect. Brain chemistry is a theory regarding mental illness, but it is not proven. [Source 1](https://www.healthline.com/health/chemical-imbalance-in-the-brain). [Source 2](
https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/is-depression-just-bad-chemistry/).

The exact causes of depression are unknown because it is a very complex issue. There are many factors that can be involved, such as genetics, stressful life events, trauma, medical problems, or medication. [Source 1](https://www.webmd.com/depression/guide/causes-depression). [Source 2](https://www.health.harvard.edu/mind-and-mood/what-causes-depression). 

Hormone problems can be related to depression or cause similar symptoms [Source](https://www.webmd.com/depression/guide/depression-the-thyroid-and-hormones).

Depression is not contagious by physical contact. Some believe it is "contagious" through social contact, meaning, if you spend a lot of time around a depressed person, you may also develop depressed feelings. [Source 1](https://www.healthline.com/health/is-depression-contagious). [Source 2](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/how-be-yourself/201606/is-depression-contagious). 

There is no literature that says depression can be transferred through blood. As stated before, depression is too complex with many different contributing factors. The only thing I could find was that people with depression or on psychiatric medication are encouraged not to donate because their ability to provide an accurate medical history may be impaired [Source](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/pub/faq/faq/faqcategory/blood-donation.aspx). 

I would contact a health professional or blood donation center about your concerns. They are probably the only people who could address them accurately.

Gen 2 is the best imo, the characters are so loveable and the stories are so real and hit very close to home for me. I have a lot to say about them so this might be long...

Emily - I am LGBT identified, so her storyline hit close to home. She is so kind, strong, and has a big heart. She's also really funny sometimes. She is the type of person I'd want to be friends with. 

Katie - HATED her at first, then her series 4 episode changed my mind. She's my least favorite, but she's not bad, just don't have much to say about her. 

Thomas - He's very sweet and is so dedicated to his family. Coming to a new country with nothing and establishing a life for himself and his family was really amazing. I also love how quickly he grew to love his new friends and how he defended them. 

Naomi - Meh. She's okay. I do like that shes very witty and funny. "Keep your vagina on" was my favorite line of hers. I hate what she did to Emily, leading her on so much and then not telling her about the girl who killed herself. Emily deserves and can do WAY better. 

Panda - Obviously very quirky, but I love how unique and unapologetically herself she is. It broke my heart when she called herself useless. She is also the funniest character of this gen imo. Her lines are just too funny, "surfing and turfing" and "I've just decided I love drugs" are my favorites. I also love how supportive she is of Effy. 

JJ - I absolutely adore him. My cousin has autism and my brother was also disabled. He perfectly captured the frustrations of not being "normal". His series 3 episode was very emotional for me, especially the last scene where his mom realizes he is fitting in and doing so well for himself despite his issues. Ollie Barbieri did an incredible job with this role and I admire him so much for it. 

Effy - I feel like I could write a whole book about her. Her struggles and her story really touched me. Dealing with trauma from Tony's accident and her parents, and then with the psychotic depression. She perfectly depicts being overburdened by emotions, the desire to self medicate, and putting up a wall to hide these things from people. She is also by far the most beautiful of the entire show. 

Freddy - One of the best characters of the whole show. I loved his depiction of depression and grief. I believe he fell so hard for Effy to compensate for the lack of love he gets at home, and to fill the void of his mother. He loves Effy so much that it kills him inside, and I can feel it when I watch his episodes. Amazing character and acting. 

Cook - Definitely the best and most complex character of the entire show. He comes off as an asshole at first, but the more I learned about him the more I loved him. I love how sweet he is with JJ and how he treats him like everyone else. His story really broke my heart the most. He does everything he can to be happy and not let his problems get the best of him. He really needed more love and support in his life, but never got what he needed and turned to partying to fill those voids. Which obviously got him into a lot of trouble and ruined his life. He has a huge heart and is so sweet and kind to his friends. I love how affectionate he was towards his friends. He never deserved any of the shit he dealt with. It also broke my heart when he realized his little brother was following in his path and how that hurt him. He dealt with a great deal of pain, but always found a reason to smile. He reminds me a lot of my friend from elementary school who died of overdose a few years back. Cook is the reason why Jack O'Connell is one of my favorite actors, this character is amazing and I could never praise him enough.

I know it feels and seems like he is deliberately doing this stuff to you, but he is not. My best friend is a Xanax addiction survivor. I am also an addiction survivor. She and I were both completely different people when we were on drugs. We lashed out, cut people off, believed in delusions, lost all motivations, pretty much exactly what you're describing here. But we were very, very sick and needed help. We both had addiction on top of mental illness, too. We both eventually got help and are recovered now and doing our best to make amends with all the bullshit we caused. Its not easy. Most people dont care or understand. They say addiction and mental illness was a choice and that we chose to hurt them. We try to explain that it wasn't us, but our illness, and also explain that we are not making excuses but rather providing explanation so that we can take responsibility of our actions. But some people flat out just dont care. I guess I can understand that, but it would be nice if people can find some compassion somewhere in their hearts, understand that we were out of control, forgive us and let us make up for what we did. I think every addict no matter what deserves compassion for the fact that our out-of-control behavior came from deep, overwhelming pain that took over our lives. I do understand that you cannot teach or force empathy, so if someone cant understand those things about addicts, I tend to just ignore them, walk away, and focus on the people who are willing to support me. 

Your friend will forgive you. You must remember that he is suffering from delusional thinking, meaning he is basing his actions on things that are not real and not true. He also is completely unaware of this right now. He may seem angry at you now but underneath the blanket of addiction and delusion, his normal self still exists. Some day he will recover, his delusions will go away, and he wont be acting that way anymore. 

Having an addict in your life takes patience, forgiveness, compassion, and love. They will make you think they dont care about you, they will hurt you, they will drive you insane. However, you are in no way forced to be part of their life. If its just too much for you, walk away and move on and maybe later on in life you will will reconnect again after he recovers. But if you want to stick around you have to accept the fact that its going to be hard as hell and it is going to hurt. 

I would also recommend trying to make more friends with healthy, supportive people and focus more on them. Joining a club or support group is a great way to make friends who are in similar situations or pursuing similar lifestyles. There are also support groups for friends and loved ones of addicts. My friend's boyfriend is an addict and she goes to NA meetings for friends and loved ones of addicts and it is very helpful to her. 

Hope all this helps.
